Metadata.title: Sunday Software Solutions — Business Intelligence Agents, AI Automation & App Support
Metadata.description: We connect your data, processes and applications so you can understand your business and cut manual work. Business intelligence agents, AI-driven automation, and application support & modernization.

Hero.description: Sunday helps mid-size companies connect data, processes and applications: financial and operational questions answered in plain language, manual work automated, and business-critical applications documented, maintained and evolved.
Hero.audience: Built for CFOs, operations and IT — no commitment to start the conversation.
Hero.diagramCaption: Service overview diagram. Illustrative — no real data.

Problems.title: Data that doesn't talk to each other, processes that depend on people.

items.1: Getting a figure like outstanding receivables means requesting a report and waiting for days.
items.2: Sales or inventory swings get explained too late — when there's no time left to act.
items.3: Teams re-key by hand data that already exists in the systems.
items.4: Internal applications no one documented, whose vendor no longer answers.
items.5: Knowledge sits in one or two people — and so does the risk.
items.6: Reports that should generate themselves get rebuilt by hand every month.

Problems.outro: Technology isn't what's missing. What's missing is connection, context, and someone to keep it alive.

Services.title: Three lines, one goal: an operation that sustains itself.

bi.title: Business Intelligence Agents
bi.tagline: Ask in plain language; answers come from your data.
bi.description: Agents that answer financial and operational questions by consulting your authorized sources — ERP, databases, existing systems — and respond in plain language, within the permissions and business definitions we agree on.

examples.2: Sales variances by period and customer

bi.note: Results depend on your data, permissions and agreed definitions. They don't replace financial advice.

auto.title: AI-Driven Automation
auto.description: We automate processes that cross applications, documents, APIs, databases and approval flows. Custom development and Microsoft integrations are part of this capability — not a separate pitch.
auto.note: Every workflow is scoped and validated with you before anything reaches production.

support.title: Application Support & Legacy Modernization
support.tagline: Applications documented, maintained, and with a future.
support.description: Diagnosis, documentation and maintenance for internal applications — including the ones nobody documented and the ones your vendor no longer supports — so they can be maintained and evolved with confidence.
support.note: Support starts with an assessment of access, code and testability. We don't take any application on faith — and the vision includes AI-assisted support and a recurring service.

UseCases.kicker: What this looks like in an operation
UseCases.title: Three scenarios, all illustrative.
UseCases.note: Illustrative examples of typical patterns — not descriptions of specific clients.

vis.question: Question
vis.a: Per-customer breakdown · straight from the ERP

bi.title: Your team asks; the ERP answers.
bi.body: Instead of waiting for month-end closing, a finance lead asks "what do we have outstanding from customers beyond 60 days?" and gets the answer with a per-customer breakdown, taken directly from ERP balances.

auto.title: Documents stop being typed twice.
auto.body: An invoice arrives → fields are read → validated against the system → an approval is routed → the entry is posted. No one re-types the information.

support.title: An application nobody knew is under control again.
support.body: Its rules and dependencies get documented, operation stabilizes, and the next change no longer depends on one person's memory.

Method.title: A method that turns opaque systems into manageable assets.

1.title: Assess
1.body: We look at the real state: systems, data, business rules and how operations actually run today.

2.title: Document & connect
2.body: We document systems and rules, define environment guidelines, and set up diagnostic, build, testing and reconciliation tooling that underpins any later change.

3.title: Implement & validate
3.body: We build agents and automations on that context, with verifiable tooling, human review and releases controlled by risk.

4.title: Maintain & evolve
4.body: Knowledge stays recorded, backed by a recurring service for monitoring, support and agreed improvements.

Method.benefitsTitle: Why this method makes the work reliable

benefits.3: Less dependence on a single person
benefits.4: Legacy systems stay maintainable and improvable

Relationship.title: We start with clear scope and continue by agreement.

initial.title: Initial implementation
initial.body: A project with agreed scope, milestones and outcomes for your first need: an agent, an automation, or a stabilized application.

recurrent.title: Recurring service
recurrent.body: Monitoring, support and maintenance within a defined scope — when your operation calls for it. Focus on improvements, not firefighting.

growth.title: Additional improvements
growth.body: Continuous evolution by agreement: new questions, new automations, new integrations.

Relationship.honestNote: Every commitment is defined in writing for your case. No "24/7 total coverage". No promises without scope.

Company.title: A practice built around connecting what you already have — and keeping it alive.
Company.p1: Sunday is a software and AI practice for mid-size companies. We work where valuable data, processes and applications already exist, but connecting them, understanding them and operating them takes too much manual work.
Company.p2: Our founder has implemented internal agents connected to business systems — including a legacy ERP — for financial and operational questions. We introduce ourselves without theater: we know what must be documented, tested and validated before results are promised.
Company.honestNote: We don't make things up: every example on this page is labeled illustrative.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Sunday Software Solutions collects, uses, and shares information.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Sunday Software Solutions handles information when you visit our website, contact us, or use our business automation services.

information.title: Information We May Collect
information.intro: We may collect information you provide or that is needed to operate our website and services, including:

items.name: Your name, business name, role, email address, and phone or WhatsApp number.
items.messages: Messages, project requirements, and other information you voluntarily share through contact forms or WhatsApp.
items.technical: Basic technical information necessary to operate the website and services.

items.services: To deliver and improve our business automation services.

providers.title: Service Providers and Sharing
providers.intro: We may use service providers that help us operate our business, including providers of:

items.whatsapp: The WhatsApp Business Platform when you contact us through WhatsApp.
items.ai: AI processing used to organize and respond to business inquiries.

providers.sharing: We share information only with service providers needed to operate the service or when legally required.
providers.noSale: Sunday Software Solutions does not sell personal information.

sensitive.title: Please Do Not Send Sensitive Information
sensitive.body: Do not send passwords, API keys, banking data, or sensitive confidential information through WhatsApp or our contact forms.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain information only as long as reasonably necessary for the inquiry, service relationship, legal obligations, and security.

items.access: Request access to your personal information.
items.deletion: Request deletion of your personal information.

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the effective date above.
